_note: All profiles use Codex's built-in image_gen tool through the ChatGPT account (no API fees). That tool has no model/quality/size parameter - the server picks the image model - so a profile is a role preset: style notes appended to the brief, plus transparency. Add your own roles here.

default.roles: Any image without a specific role preset.

photoreal.roles: Product shots, hero banners, lifestyle and editorial photography.
photoreal.style_notes: Photorealistic, as shot on a full-frame camera: physically plausible light and shadows, real material textures, natural color grading, no illustrated or CGI look, no text unless the brief specifies it.

illustration.roles: Blog/marketing illustrations, onboarding art, spot illustrations, storybook scenes.
illustration.style_notes: Cohesive illustration style: consistent line weight, limited palette from the brief, clean shapes, readable silhouette, no photographic textures.

icon.roles: App icons, UI icons, logos-as-marks, stickers, sprites.
icon.style_notes: Centered single subject with generous padding, flat or lightly shaded, max 3-4 colors, bold readable shape that still works at 32px, no text, transparent background.

ui-asset.roles: App/web mockup art, dashboard hero visuals, device mockups, empty-state art.
ui-asset.style_notes: Crisp, modern product-design aesthetic; precise geometry; any UI text short and spelled exactly as in the brief; avoid fake unreadable micro-text - leave text areas as clean blocks instead.

text-heavy.roles: Posters, covers, infographics, slides-as-images where typography matters.
text-heavy.style_notes: Typography is the priority: render every string exactly (spelling, case, diacritics), strong hierarchy, generous margins, no extra words, no lorem ipsum.
